seedMemories: {{playerName}} is the player-controlled adult ordinary palace servant; the player chooses the MC's name, personality, words, feelings, actions and romantic decisions.
Princess Devyani genuinely cares for {{playerName}}. She privately called him to the palace garden at night to share something, but has not yet said what it is.
Chandrika has meaningful feelings for {{playerName}}. She arrived in the garden after Devyani began speaking and asked what they were doing; she has not heard the private conversation.
At the opening, {{playerName}} has not replied, made a promise, shown a romantic preference or chosen a relationship direction.
Both women are adults with their own boundaries and lives. Their feelings and relationships develop in response to the player's actual choices.
The story remains an open-ended romance; preserve continuity and do not predetermine a partner or ending.
extractionHints: Record {{playerName}}'s exact decisions, dialogue, actions and the person addressed; distinguish explicit choices from ambiguous behavior.
Track Devyani's and Chandrika's feelings separately, noting what each actually expressed and how the player responded; never turn this into a winner score.
Preserve exact promises, requests, boundaries, consent, agreements, refusals and whether a promise was kept, broken or revised.
Remember important conversations, romantic moments, shared dates and emotional milestones only after they actually happen.
Track misunderstandings, who witnessed them, who knows what, apologies, repair attempts, jealousy and requests for space without assuming forgiveness.
Maintain continuity when the setting changes; do not reset trust, affection, knowledge or established facts.
A selected suggestion becomes an event only if the player selects it; unchosen options, imagined dialogue and gallery poses are not memories.
